title.zh: 卷九十七 列傳第二十七: 耶律斡特剌 孩里 竇景庸 耶律引吉 楊績 趙徽 王觀 耶律喜孫
title.en: Volume 97 Biographies 27: Yelu Wotela, Hai Li, Dou Jingyong, Yelu Yinji, Yang Ji, Zhao Hui, Wang Guan, Yelu Xisun
title.raw: 卷九十七 列傳第二十七: 耶律斡特剌 孩里 竇景庸 耶律引吉 楊績 趙徽 王觀 耶律喜孫 Volume 97 Biographies 27: Yelu Wotela, Hai Li, Dou Jingyong, Yelu Yinji, Yang Ji, Zhao Hui, Wang Guan, Yelu Xisun

sentences.zh: 耶律斡特剌孩裏竇景庸耶律引吉楊績趙徽王觀耶律喜孫

translations.literal: Yelu Wotela, Hai Li, Dou Jingyong, Yelu Yinji, Yang Ji, Zhao Hui, Wang Guan, Yelu Xisun
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Wotela, Hai Li, Dou Jingyong, Yelu Yinji, Yang Ji, Zhao Hui, Wang Guan, and Yelu Xisun

sentences.zh: 耶律斡特剌，字乙辛隱，許國王寅底石六世孫。

translations.literal: Yelu Wotela, style name Yixin Yin, was a sixth-generation descendant of Prince Xu of State, Yindi.
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Wotela, whose style name was Yixin Yin, was a sixth-generation descendant of Prince Xu of State, Yindi.

sentences.zh: 少不喜官祿，年四十一，始補本班郎君。

translations.literal: In youth he cared little for official salary and rank; not until age forty-one did he first receive appointment as an attendant of the standard corps.
translations.idiomatic: As a young man he cared little for office and emolument; only at forty-one did he first receive appointment as an attendant of the standard corps.

sentences.zh: 時樞密使耶律乙辛擅權，讒害忠良，斡特剌恐禍及，深自抑畏。

translations.literal: At the time the Commissioner of Military Affairs Yelu Yixin monopolized power and slandered the loyal and worthy; Wotela feared calamity would reach him and deeply restrained and humbled himself.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Yelu Yixin, Commissioner of Military Affairs, held power arbitrarily and slandered loyal ministers; fearing that disaster might reach him, Wotela kept himself deeply subdued and cautious.

sentences.zh: 大康中，為宿直官，歷左、右護衛太保。

translations.literal: In the Dakang era he served as a night-duty officer and successively held the posts of Left and Right Guard Commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: During the Dakang era he served on night duty at court and successively held the posts of Left and Right Guard Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 大安元年，升燕王傅，徙左夷離畢。

translations.literal: In the first year of Da'an he was promoted to Tutor to the Prince of Yan and transferred to Left Tribal Affairs Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Da'an he was promoted to Tutor to the Prince of Yan and transferred to the post of Left Tribal Affairs Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 四年，改北院樞密副使。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was changed to Vice Commissioner of the Northern Administration of the Imperial Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was appointed Vice Commissioner of the Northern Administration.

sentences.zh: 帝賜詩褒之，遷知北院樞密使事，賜翼聖佐義功臣。

translations.literal: The emperor bestowed a poem in praise of him, promoted him to Acting Commissioner of the Northern Administration, and granted him the merit title "Worthy Assistant in Supporting the Sage."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor composed a poem in his praise, promoted him to Acting Commissioner of the Northern Administration, and granted him the merit title Worthy Assistant in Supporting the Sage.

sentences.zh: 北阻卜酋長磨古斯叛，斡特剌率兵進討。

translations.literal: The chief of the northern Zubu, Mogusi, rebelled, and Wotela led troops forward to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: When Mogusi, chief of the northern Zubu, rebelled, Wotela led troops to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 會天大雪，敗磨古斯四別部，斬首千餘級，拜西北路招討使，封漆水郡王，加賜宣力守正功臣。

translations.literal: It happened that heaven sent heavy snow; he defeated four sub-divisions of Mogusi's forces, beheaded more than a thousand, was appointed Commissioner for Pacification of the Northwest Route, enfeoffed as Prince of Qishui Commandery, and further granted the merit title "Upholding Integrity with Dedicated Strength."
translations.idiomatic: Heavy snow fell at the time; he defeated four of Mogusi's sub-divisions, took more than a thousand heads, was appointed Commissioner for Pacification of the Northwest Route, enfeoffed as Prince of Qishui Commandery, and further granted the merit title Upholding Integrity with Dedicated Strength.

sentences.zh: 尋拜南府宰相。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was appointed Chancellor of the Southern Administration.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed Chancellor of the Southern Administration.

sentences.zh: 復討閘古胡裏扒部，破之，召為契丹行宮都部署。

translations.literal: He again attacked the Zanguhuliba tribe, defeated them, and was summoned to serve as Chief Deployer of the Khitan Imperial Camp.
translations.idiomatic: He again campaigned against the Zanguhuliba tribe, defeated them, and was summoned to serve as Chief Deployer of the Khitan Imperial Camp.

sentences.zh: 先是，北、南府有訟，各州府得就按之；

translations.literal: Previously, when the Northern and Southern Administrations had lawsuits, each prefecture and district could go and investigate them on the spot;
translations.idiomatic: Previously, when the Northern and Southern Administrations had lawsuits, each prefecture and district could go on site to investigate them;

sentences.zh: 比歲，非奉樞密檄，不得鞫問，以故訟者稽留。

translations.literal: in recent years, unless carrying an order from the Military Affairs Commission, one could not conduct interrogations, and for this reason litigants were detained.
translations.idiomatic: in recent years, however, unless one held an order from the Military Affairs Commission, one could not conduct interrogations, and for this reason litigants were long detained.

sentences.zh: 斡特剌奏請如舊，從之。

translations.literal: Wotela memorialized requesting that the old practice be restored, and the request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Wotela memorialized asking that the former practice be restored, and the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 壽隆五年，復為西北路招討使，討耶睹刮部，俘斬甚眾，獲馬、駝、牛、羊各數萬。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Shoulong he again served as Commissioner for Pacification of the Northwest Route, campaigning against the Yedugua tribe; he captured and beheaded a great many, and obtained tens of thousands each of horses, camels, cattle, and sheep.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Shoulong he again served as Commissioner for Pacification of the Northwest Route and campaigned against the Yedugua tribe, capturing and beheading a great many and taking tens of thousands each of horses, camels, cattle, and sheep.

sentences.zh: 明年，擒磨古斯，加守太保，賜奉國匡化功臣。

translations.literal: The next year he captured Mogusi, was promoted to Defender Grand Guardian, and was granted the merit title "Supporting the State and Rectifying Transformation."
translations.idiomatic: The following year he captured Mogusi, was promoted to Defender Grand Guardian, and was granted the merit title Supporting the State and Rectifying Transformation.

sentences.zh: 乾統初，乞致仕，不許，止罷招討。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qiantong he requested retirement, but was not permitted; he was only removed from the pacification command.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Qiantong he asked to retire, but permission was refused; he was only removed from the pacification command.

sentences.zh: 復兼南院樞密使，封混同郡王。

translations.literal: He again concurrently held the post of Commissioner of the Southern Administration and was enfeoffed as Prince of Huntong Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: He again served concurrently as Commissioner of the Southern Administration and was enfeoffed as Prince of Huntong Commandery.

sentences.zh: 遷北院樞密使，加守太師，賜推誠贊治功臣。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Commissioner of the Northern Administration, promoted to Defender Grand Preceptor, and granted the merit title "Sincere in Counsel and Praiseworthy in Governance."
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Commissioner of the Northern Administration, promoted to Defender Grand Preceptor, and granted the merit title Sincere in Counsel and Praiseworthy in Governance.

sentences.zh: 致仕，薨，謚曰敬肅。

translations.literal: He retired, died, and was posthumously titled Jingsu.
translations.idiomatic: He retired from office, died, and was posthumously titled Jingsu.

sentences.zh: 孩裏，字胡輦，回鶻人。

translations.literal: Hai Li, style name Hunian, was a Uyghur.
translations.idiomatic: Hai Li, whose style name was Hunian, was a Uyghur.

sentences.zh: 其先在太祖時來貢，願留，因任用之。

translations.literal: His forebears had come to offer tribute in the time of Taizu, wished to remain, and were therefore employed in office.
translations.idiomatic: His ancestors had come to offer tribute in the time of Taizu, asked to remain, and were therefore given office.

sentences.zh: 孩裏重熙間歷近侍長。

translations.literal: In the Chongxi era Hai Li successively served as chief palace attendant.
translations.idiomatic: During the Chongxi era Hai Li successively served as chief palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 清寧九年，討重元之亂有功，加金吾衛上將軍，賜平亂功臣。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Qingning he had merit in suppressing the rebellion of Chongyuan and was promoted to General-in-Chief of the Golden Crow Guard, granted the merit title "Pacifier of Disorder."
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Qingning he had merit in suppressing the rebellion of Chongyuan and was promoted to General-in-Chief of the Golden Crow Guard and granted the merit title Pacifier of Disorder.

sentences.zh: 累遷殿前都點檢，以宿衛嚴肅稱。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Commander of the Palace Front and was known for the strictness of his palace guard service.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly promoted until he became Commander of the Palace Front and was known for the strictness with which he maintained palace guard duty.

sentences.zh: 大康初，加守太子太保。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Dakang he was promoted to Defender Heir Apparent Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Dakang he was promoted to Defender Heir Apparent Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 二年，加同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the second year he was promoted to Associate Director of the Department of State Affairs with the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was promoted to Associate Director of the Department of State Affairs with the Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 三年，改同知南院宣徽使事。

translations.literal: In the third year he was changed to Vice Director of the Southern Administration Commissioner of the Imperial Household.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was transferred to Vice Director of the Southern Administration Commissioner of the Imperial Household.

sentences.zh: 會耶律乙辛出守中京，孩裏入賀；

translations.literal: When Yelu Yixin went out to guard the Central Capital, Hai Li entered court to offer congratulations;
translations.idiomatic: When Yelu Yixin went out to guard the Central Capital, Hai Li entered court to offer congratulations;

sentences.zh: 及議復召，陳其不可。

translations.literal: when deliberation turned to recalling him again, Hai Li stated that this should not be done.
translations.idiomatic: when the court deliberated recalling him, Hai Li argued that this should not be done.

sentences.zh: 後乙辛再入樞府，出孩裏為廣利軍節度使。

translations.literal: Later, when Yixin again entered the Military Affairs Commission, he had Hai Li sent out as Military Commissioner of Guangli Army.
translations.idiomatic: Later, when Yixin again entered the Military Affairs Commission, he had Hai Li sent out as Military Commissioner of Guangli Army.

sentences.zh: 及皇太子被誣，孩裏當連坐，有詔勿問。

translations.literal: When the crown prince was falsely accused, Hai Li would have been implicated by association, but an edict ordered that he not be prosecuted.
translations.idiomatic: When the crown prince was falsely accused, Hai Li would have been implicated by association, but an edict ordered that he not be prosecuted.

sentences.zh: 大安初，歷品達魯虢部節度使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Da'an he successively served as Military Commissioner of the Pindaluoguo Division.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Da'an he successively served as Military Commissioner of the Pindaluoguo Division.

sentences.zh: 壽隆五年，有疾，自言吾數已盡，卻醫藥，卒，年七十七。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Shoulong he fell ill, saying himself that his allotted span was exhausted; he refused medicine and died, aged seventy-seven.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Shoulong he fell ill, declaring that his allotted span was exhausted; he refused medicine and died at seventy-seven.

sentences.zh: 孩裏素信浮圖。

translations.literal: Hai Li had long believed in Buddhism.
translations.idiomatic: Hai Li had long been a believer in Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 清寧初，從上獵，墮馬，憒而復蘇。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qingning, while accompanying the emperor on a hunt, he fell from his horse, lost consciousness, and then revived.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Qingning, while accompanying the emperor on a hunt, he fell from his horse, lost consciousness, and then revived.

sentences.zh: 言始見二人引至一城，宮室宏敞，有衣絳袍人坐殿上，左右列侍，導孩裏升階。

translations.literal: He said that at first he saw two men lead him to a city whose palaces and halls were vast and grand; a man in a crimson robe sat upon the dais, attendants stood in rows to left and right, and they guided Hai Li up the steps.
translations.idiomatic: He said that at first two men led him to a city of vast palaces and halls, where a man in a crimson robe sat upon the dais with attendants ranked to left and right, and they guided Hai Li up the steps.

sentences.zh: 持牘者示之曰：「本取大腹骨欲，誤執汝。」

translations.literal: The man holding the document showed it to him and said: "We originally meant to take Dafugu, but mistakenly seized you."
translations.idiomatic: The man holding the document showed it to him and said, "We originally meant to take Dafugu, but mistakenly seized you.

sentences.zh: 牘上書「官至使相，壽七十七」。

translations.literal: On the document was written: "Office reaches commissioner and chancellor; lifespan seventy-seven."
translations.idiomatic: On the document was written, "Office reaches commissioner and chancellor; lifespan seventy-seven."

sentences.zh: 須臾還，擠之大壑而寤。

translations.literal: After a moment he returned, was pushed into a great ravine, and awoke.
translations.idiomatic: After a moment he was sent back, thrust into a great ravine, and awoke.

sentences.zh: 道宗聞之，命書其事。

translations.literal: Emperor Daozong heard of it and ordered the affair written down.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Daozong heard of it and ordered the affair recorded in writing.

sentences.zh: 後皆驗。

translations.literal: Later events all verified it.
translations.idiomatic: Later events all proved it true.

sentences.zh: 耶律引吉，字阿括，品部人。

translations.literal: Yelu Yinji, style name Akuo, was a man of the Pin tribe.
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Yinji, whose style name was Akuo, was a man of the Pin tribe.

sentences.zh: 父雙古，鎮西邊二十餘年，治尚嚴肅，不殖貨利，時多稱之。

translations.literal: His father Shuanggu guarded the western frontier for more than twenty years; his governance valued strictness, he did not pursue profit, and at the time many praised him.
translations.idiomatic: His father Shuanggu guarded the western frontier for more than twenty years; his governance was strict, he did not pursue profit, and at the time many praised him.

sentences.zh: 引吉寅畏好義。

translations.literal: Yinji was cautious and respectful and loved righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: Yinji was cautious and respectful and loved righteousness.

sentences.zh: 以蔭補官，累遷東京副留守、北樞密院侍御。

translations.literal: Through hereditary privilege he entered office and was repeatedly promoted to Vice Military Governor of the Eastern Capital and Palace Attendant of the Northern Military Affairs Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Through hereditary privilege he entered office and was repeatedly promoted to Vice Military Governor of the Eastern Capital and Palace Attendant of the Northern Military Affairs Commission.

sentences.zh: 時蕭革、蕭圖古辭等以佞見任，鬻爵納賄，引吉以直道處其間，無所阿唯。

translations.literal: At the time Xiao Ge, Xiao Tuguci, and others were employed for their flattery, selling offices and accepting bribes; Yinji stood among them by the straight path and did not fawn or agree to anything.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Xiao Ge, Xiao Tuguci, and others were employed for their flattery, selling offices and accepting bribes; Yinji stood among them on the straight path and would not fawn or agree to anything.

sentences.zh: 改客省使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Reception Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to the post of Reception Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 時朝廷遣使括三京隱戶不得，以引吉代之，得數千餘戶。

translations.literal: At the time the court had sent envoys to register hidden households in the Three Capitals without success; Yinji replaced them and obtained more than several thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the court had sent envoys to register hidden households in the Three Capitals without success; Yinji replaced them and obtained more than several thousand households.

sentences.zh: 時昭懷太子知北南院事，選引吉為輔導。

translations.literal: At the time Crown Prince Zhaohuai oversaw the affairs of the Northern and Southern Administrations and selected Yinji as his instructor.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Crown Prince Zhaohuai oversaw the affairs of the Northern and Southern Administrations and selected Yinji as his instructor.

sentences.zh: 樞密使乙辛將傾太子，惡引吉在側，奏出之，為群牧林牙。

translations.literal: The Commissioner of Military Affairs Yixin was about to bring down the crown prince and hated Yinji at his side; he memorialized to have him sent out and appointed him Commissioner of Herds.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner of Military Affairs Yixin was about to bring down the crown prince and hated having Yinji at his side; he memorialized to have him sent out and appointed him Commissioner of Herds.

sentences.zh: 大康元年，乙辛請賜牧地，引吉奏曰：「今牧地褊狹，畜不蕃息，豈可分賜臣下。」

translations.literal: In the first year of Dakang, Yixin requested that pasture lands be granted; Yinji memorialized, saying: "At present the pasture lands are narrow and cramped and livestock do not multiply—how can they be divided and granted to subordinates?"
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Dakang, Yixin requested that pasture lands be granted; Yinji memorialized, saying, "At present the pasture lands are narrow and cramped and livestock do not multiply—how can they be divided and granted to subordinates?

sentences.zh: 帝乃止。

translations.literal: The emperor thereupon stopped the matter.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor thereupon stopped the matter.

sentences.zh: 乙辛由是益嫉之，除懷德軍節度使，徙漠北猾水馬群太保，卒。

translations.literal: Yixin therefore hated him all the more, removed him as Military Commissioner of Huaide Army, transferred him to Grand Guardian of the Huashui Horse Herds in the far north, and he died.
translations.idiomatic: Yixin therefore hated him all the more, removed him as Military Commissioner of Huaide Army, transferred him to Grand Guardian of the Huashui Horse Herds in the far north, and he died in office.

sentences.zh: 趙徽，南京人。

translations.literal: Zhao Hui was a man of the Southern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Hui was a native of the Southern Capital.

sentences.zh: 重熙五年，擢甲科，累遷大理正。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Chongxi he passed the examinations in the top grade and was repeatedly promoted to Chief of the Court of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Chongxi he passed the examinations in the top grade and was repeatedly promoted until he became Chief of the Court of Justice.

sentences.zh: 清寧二年，銅州人妄毀三教，徽按鞫之，以狀聞，稱旨。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qingning a man of Tong Prefecture wantonly slandered the Three Teachings; Hui investigated and interrogated the case, reported it in a memorial, and pleased the emperor's intent.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Qingning a man of Tong Prefecture wantonly slandered the Three Teachings; Hui investigated and interrogated the case, reported it in a memorial, and pleased the emperor.

sentences.zh: 歷煩劇，有能名。

translations.literal: He passed through arduous and demanding posts and had a reputation for ability.
translations.idiomatic: He passed through arduous and demanding posts and earned a reputation for ability.

sentences.zh: 累遷翰林學士承旨。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Academician Expositor-in-Chief of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly promoted to Academician Expositor-in-Chief of the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 咸雍初，為度支使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xianyong he served as Commissioner of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Xianyong he served as Commissioner of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 三年，拜參知政事。

translations.literal: In the third year he was appointed Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was appointed Vice Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 出為武定軍節度使，及代，軍民請留。

translations.literal: He went out as Military Commissioner of Wuding Army, and when his term ended the soldiers and people asked that he be retained.
translations.idiomatic: He went out as Military Commissioner of Wuding Army, and when his term ended the soldiers and people asked that he be retained.

sentences.zh: 後同知樞密院事，兼南府宰相、門下侍郎、平章事。

translations.literal: Later he served as Vice Director of the Military Affairs Commission, concurrently Chancellor of the Southern Administration, Vice Minister of the Chancellery, and Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Later he served as Vice Director of the Military Affairs Commission, concurrently Chancellor of the Southern Administration, Vice Minister of the Chancellery, and Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 致仕，卒。

translations.literal: He retired and died.
translations.idiomatic: He retired from office and died.

sentences.zh: 追贈中書令，謚文憲。

translations.literal: Posthumously he was granted the title of Director of the Department of State Affairs and posthumously titled Wenxian.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously he was granted the title of Director of the Department of State Affairs and given the posthumous title Wenxian.

sentences.zh: 王觀，南京人。

translations.literal: Wang Guan was a man of the Southern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Guan was a native of the Southern Capital.

sentences.zh: 博學有才辯。

translations.literal: He was broadly learned and had talent for rhetoric.
translations.idiomatic: He was broadly learned and had a gift for rhetoric.

sentences.zh: 重熙七年，中進士乙科。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Chongxi he passed the civil examinations in the second grade.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Chongxi he passed the civil examinations in the second grade.

sentences.zh: 興宗崩，充夏國報哀使；

translations.literal: When Emperor Xingzong died, he served as envoy to the Xia state to announce the mourning;
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xingzong died, he served as envoy to the Xia state to announce the mourning;

sentences.zh: 還，除給事中。

translations.literal: on his return he was appointed Supervising Censor.
translations.idiomatic: on his return he was appointed Supervising Censor.

sentences.zh: 咸雍初，遷翰林學士。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xianyong he was promoted to Hanlin Academician.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Xianyong he was promoted to Hanlin Academician.

sentences.zh: 五年，兼乾文閣學士。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he additionally served as Academician of the Qianwen Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he additionally served as Academician of the Qianwen Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 七年，改南院樞密副使，賜國姓，參知政事，兼知南院樞密事。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was changed to Vice Commissioner of the Southern Administration, granted the imperial surname, appointed Vice Grand Councilor, and concurrently Acting Commissioner of the Southern Administration.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was changed to Vice Commissioner of the Southern Administration, granted the imperial surname, appointed Vice Grand Councilor, and concurrently Acting Commissioner of the Southern Administration.

sentences.zh: 坐矯制修私第，削爵為民，卒。

translations.literal: He was punished for forging an edict to build a private residence, stripped of his rank and made a commoner, and died.
translations.idiomatic: He was punished for forging an edict to build a private residence, was stripped of his rank and reduced to commoner status, and died.

sentences.zh: 耶律喜孫，字盈隱，永興宮分人。

translations.literal: Yelu Xisun, style name Yinyin, was a man of the Yongxing Palace Division.
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Xisun, whose style name was Yinyin, was a man of the Yongxing Palace Division.

sentences.zh: 興宗在青宮，嘗居左右輔導。

translations.literal: When Xingzong was in the Eastern Palace, Xisun had once served at his side as instructor.
translations.idiomatic: When Xingzong was heir apparent in the Eastern Palace, Xisun had once served at his side as instructor.

sentences.zh: 聖宗大漸，喜孫與馮家奴告仁德皇后同宰相蕭浞卜等謀逆事。

translations.literal: When Emperor Shengzong was critically ill, Xisun together with Feng Jianu reported that Empress Rende and the chancellor Xiao Pobu and others were plotting treason.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Shengzong was critically ill, Xisun together with Feng Jianu reported that Empress Rende, Chancellor Xiao Pobu, and others were plotting treason.

sentences.zh: 及欽哀為皇太后稱制，喜孫尤見寵任。

translations.literal: When Empress Dowager Qin'ai assumed regency, Xisun was especially favored and trusted.
translations.idiomatic: When Empress Dowager Qin'ai assumed regency, Xisun was especially favored and trusted.

sentences.zh: 重熙中，其子涅哥為近侍，坐事伏誅。

translations.literal: In the Chongxi era his son Niege served as a palace attendant and was executed for an offense.
translations.idiomatic: During the Chongxi era his son Niege served as a palace attendant and was executed for an offense.

sentences.zh: 帝以喜孫有翼戴功，且悼其子罪死，欲世其官，喜孫無所出之部，因見馬印文有品部號，使隸其部，拜南府宰相。

translations.literal: The emperor, because Xisun had merit in supporting his accession and also grieved that his son had died for a crime, wished to make his office hereditary; as Xisun had no division of origin, seeing on a horse-brand the mark of the Pin tribe, he had him attached to that tribe and appointed him Chancellor of the Southern Administration.
translations.idiomatic: Because Xisun had merit in supporting the emperor's accession and the emperor also grieved that his son had died for a crime, he wished to make his office hereditary; as Xisun had no division of origin, the emperor saw on a horse-brand the mark of the Pin tribe, had him attached to that tribe, and appointed him Chancellor of the Southern Administration.

sentences.zh: 尋出為東北路詳穩，卒。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was sent out as Detailed Inspector of the Northeast Route and died.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was sent out as Detailed Inspector of the Northeast Route and died.

sentences.zh: 論曰：孩裏、引吉之為臣也，當乙辛擅權、蕭革貪黷之日，雖與同官，而能以正自處，不少阿唯，其過人遠矣。

translations.literal: The commentary says: As ministers, Hai Li and Yinji lived in the days when Yixin monopolized power and Xiao Ge was greedy and corrupt; though they held office with such men, they were able to maintain themselves by rectitude and did not fawn or agree—how far they surpassed others.
translations.idiomatic: The commentary says: As ministers, Hai Li and Yinji lived in the days when Yixin monopolized power and Xiao Ge was greedy and corrupt; though they served alongside such men, they were able to maintain themselves by rectitude and would not fawn or agree—how far they surpassed others.

sentences.zh: 傳曰：「歲寒知松柏之後雕。」

translations.literal: The Classic says: "Only when the year turns cold do we know that the pine and cypress are the last to wither."
translations.idiomatic: The Classic says, "Only when the year turns cold do we know that the pine and cypress are the last to wither.

sentences.zh: 二子有焉。

translations.literal: These two men had it.
translations.idiomatic: These two men had it.

sentences.zh: 若斡特剌之戰功，竇景庸之讞獄，楊績之忠告，亦賢矣夫。

translations.literal: As for Wotela's military achievements, Dou Jingyong's adjudication of cases, and Yang Ji's loyal counsel—they too were worthy men.
translations.idiomatic: As for Wotela's military achievements, Dou Jingyong's adjudication of cases, and Yang Ji's loyal counsel—they too were worthy men indeed.
